subject: PO lanes & temporary invoice-only path — VeriData pilot
messages:
From: Niko Hayes <niko@veridatacorp.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: VeriData pilot onboarding — PO flexibility request

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to kick off a 6-week pilot with Redwood. Procurement at VeriData prefers to use our vendor system for billing, but because this is a short, time-boxed pilot we need flexibility on the PO requirement for the first 90 days.

Can Redwood accept invoices without a PO for this pilot? If helpful, I attached the SOW and our standard pilot terms for your review. We can also provide a PO after the pilot if everything looks good.

Attachments:
- veridata-SOW.pdf (application/pdf)

Next steps we'd propose:
- Quick vendor intake today
- Pilot start next week
- If pilot succeeds, convert to annual contract + PO

Happy to hop on a call if you need more context.

Best,
Niko Hayes
Head of Partnerships, VeriData Corp
phone: +1 415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Niko Hayes <niko@veridatacorp.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VeriData pilot onboarding — PO flexibility request

Thanks Niko — great to see this moving fast.

Short version from Sales: we should accommodate an invoice-only pilot for up to 90 days for strategic prospects like VeriData. It removes friction and preserves the likelihood of conversion. I can own the risk & commercial follow-up.

What I'd like from Procurement to make this operational:
- A temporary invoice-only lane created for VeriData for up to $25K total during the pilot
- Evidence required: signed SOW, completed vendor-intake-form, billing contact + remittance details
- Finance/Procurement guardrails (records, SLA on PO issuance if deal converts)

I've attached a draft vendor-intake-form we can ask them to complete.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- vendor-intake-form.pdf (stub)

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for flagging.

We can make a temporary invoice-only path but need an explicit approval lane and a record of controls. Proposed procurement stance:

- Temporary invoice-only approval (pilot) limited to $25,000 total spend and 90 days max.
- Required evidence to enable the lane:
  * Signed SOW (received)
  * Completed vendor-intake-form (please have VeriData fill out and return)
  * Exec sponsor confirmation from Sales (Marissa) assigning owner for collection of PO if converting
- Finance tick-boxes: A dedicated GL routing code, and a Note in the vendor file indicating the temporary exception and expiry date.

If the requested pilot spend or term exceeds those limits, procurement will require a standard PO before any invoices are processed. For any exceptions beyond this I'd need Procurement Director sign-off.

Marissa — can you confirm you will own escalation to sales leadership and provide the intake form to VeriData? Karthik / Naomi — FYI on the threshold.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
phone: +1 415-555-0190

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VeriData pilot onboarding — PO flexibility request

Appreciate the clear guardrails, Irene. A couple of practical notes from Ops/Legal/procurement alignment: 

- Authority ladder: For the temporary exception (<= $25k / 90 days) Procurement Manager approval is sufficient. Anything between $25k-$50k requires Procurement Director + Finance OK. > $50k requires legal review & Procurement VP sign-off.
- Auto-expiry: Make the exception record include an auto-expiry date (90 days) and a follow-up task assigned to Sales to either obtain a PO or route to Contracting.
- Accounting: Naomi, please confirm whether we need a special accrual code or can use a general pilot GL. If accrual preferred, we should tag now.

If everyone's aligned I'll add a short playbook snippet to the vendor intake checklist and update the Procurement playbook doc.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations (acting), Redwood Inference
